dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm Hannah. So, what brings you here tonight?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! aɪm ˈhænə. soʊ, ˈwʌt ˈbrɪŋz juː ˈhɪr təˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi, Hannah. I'm Nam. A friend told me about it. I'd like to meet people from different industries.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈhænə. aɪm ˈnɑːm. ə ˈfrɛnd ˈtoʊld miː əˈbaʊt ɪt. aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈmiːt ˈpiːpəl frəm ˈdɪfərənt ˈɪndəstriz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a good reason. What line of work are you in?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡʊd ˈriːzən. ˈwʌt ˈlaɪn əv ˈwɜːrk ər juː ˈɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Education. I teach English to children. And you?
dialogue.reading: ˌɛdʒəˈkeɪʃən. aɪ ˈtiːtʃ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ tə ˈtʃɪldrən. ənd ˈjuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I work for a travel company. I'm based in Bangkok, but I'm originally from Melbourne.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɜːrk fər ə ˈtrævəl ˈkʌmpəni. aɪm ˈbeɪst ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, bʌt aɪm əˈrɪdʒənəli frəm ˈmɛlbərn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Melbourne? How come you moved to Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɛlbərn? ˈhaʊ ˈkʌm juː ˈmuːvd tə ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My company opened an office here, and they needed someone who could speak Thai.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈkʌmpəni ˈoʊpənd ən ˈɔːfɪs ˈhɪr, ənd ðeɪ ˈniːdɪd ˈsʌmwʌn huː kʊd ˈspiːk ˈtaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You speak Thai? What did you learn it for?
dialogue.reading: juː ˈspiːk ˈtaɪ? ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈlɜːrn ɪt ˈfɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: For fun, at first! I spent a year in Chiang Mai as an exchange student.
dialogue.reading: fər ˈfʌn, ət ˈfɜːrst! aɪ ˈspɛnt ə ˈjɪr ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ əz ən ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˌstuːdənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How come your Thai is so good after only one year?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈkʌm jʊr ˈtaɪ ɪz soʊ ˈɡʊd ˈæftər ˈoʊnli ˈwʌn ˈjɪr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! I practice every day with my Thai colleagues.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! aɪ ˈpræktɪs ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ wɪð maɪ ˈtaɪ ˈkɑːliːɡz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's the best way. Your accent sounds very natural!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ðə ˈbɛst ˈweɪ. jʊr ˈæksɛnt ˈsaʊndz ˈvɛri ˈnætʃərəl!
